outcome.situation_summary: 5 critical accounts identified with $17,315 combined MRR at risk. All 5 show severe DAU declines (-43% to -68%), extended inactivity, and high support loads. NovaWorks renewal is imminent in 2.1 months ($3.5K MRR). 14 of 19 accounts lack sufficient data for scoring.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 4 accounts with 4 critical and 0 at-risk. Primary risk pattern: Usage drops exceeding 50% (range 45-67%) combined with secondary signals (renewal windows 9 weeks or open support tickets 4+). All interventions completed autonomously with 100% success rate. 4 dedicated CSMs assigned for personalized outreach. No errors or manual escalations required. Patterns stored for future baseline comparison and early warning system refinement.
